enumValues.error.descriptionShape: description is a string, or null for none
enumValues.error.labelShape: label is a string, or null for none
enumValues.error.nameFromPath: The value's name is {name}, as its path says (leave name out of value, or give the same; rename with name in card_update)
enumValues.error.noEnum: {path} is not the path of an enum's value (<enum path>.<value>)
enumValues.error.path: An enum's value is made at the path <enum path>.<value> ({path})
enumValues.error.position: position is a whole number from 0
enumValues.error.valueKey: Elements of values are written with name and label (name is what value was). use holds the call written that way
enumValues.line.dataFollowed: Wrote the new name {value} over the old one in {count} values of {card}
enumValues.warn.held: The data at {paths} still has {name}: it is not changed, and the inspection lists it under cardProblems
enumValues.warn.heldOpen: The data at {paths} still has {name}: it is not changed (the enum is open, so it passes as a value it does not know)
